task: Classify tumor type in endometrial carcinoma. Classes: Endometrioid, Serous, and Mixed. Key H&E features include glandular endometrioid differentiation, papillary high-grade serous morphology, or the coexistence of both patterns in a mixed tumor.

classes.0: Endometrioid tumor with gland-forming architecture and conventional endometrial-type differentiation.
classes.1: Serous tumor with papillary or micropapillary growth, severe cytologic atypia, and high-grade nuclei.
classes.2: Mixed tumor containing distinct endometrioid and serous morphologic patterns.
